description: Use this once get_audit_status shows completed. Takes the audit_id and an optional top_n (1 to 25, default 10). Returns the issues ranked by likely impact, each with the number of affected pages, example URLs and a plain-English fix, plus a list of what was checked, what was not checked, and a note when the page limit was reached, and the full_report_url, pdf_url and csv_url links. Report the issues as given; do not add findings that are not in the result.
name: get_audit_report
title: Get audit report
